"TRICKLE CHARGER"
Day: 29 Tuesday 10-29-24

Warm Up:
10 Jumping Jacks
Crack the Knuckles
5 pushups
* Repeat as needed

1. BACK SQUAT 3 sets of 5 reps @ 55%
90 sec rest between sets
move the weight fast

2. a. DB Laterals 4 x 10 reps
super set
b. KB Swings 4 x 10 reps
c. DB or KB Farmers Walk 4 x 30 yds
90 sec rest between each super set

Cardio
Do the warm up as a cool down

Recovery
Thick Steak
Baked Taters
30 min walk
High level Sleep

This session should take 20-25 minutes

"Day 29: Trickle Charger"
Warm up: 10 Jumping Jacks, Crack the Knuckles, 5 pushups
* Repeat as needed
1. Back Squat 3 sets of 5 reps @ 55%
* Move the weight fast
rest 1:30
2. a. Dumbbell Laterals 4 sets of 10 reps
super set b. Kettlebell Swings 4 sets of 10 reps
super set c. Dumbbell or Kettlebell Farmers Walk 4 sets of 30 yds
rest 1:30 between each super set
* This session should take 20-25 minutes
Cardio: Do the warm up as a cool down
Recovery: Thick Steak · Baked Taters · 30 min walk · High level Sleep
